allow:
Bash(echo "# ============================================
# DATABASE
# ============================================
# PostgreSQL connection string
# Format: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DATABASE?schema=SCHEMA
DATABASE_URL=""postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/femmelux?schema=public""

# ============================================
# AUTHENTICATION \(JWT\)
# ============================================
# Secret keys for JWT tokens - use strong, random strings in production
# Generate with: openssl rand -base64 64
JWT_ACCESS_SECRET=""your-super-secret-access-key-change-in-production""
JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=""your-super-secret-refresh-key-change-in-production""

# Token expiration times
JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRES_IN=""15m""
JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN=""7d""

# ============================================
# REDIS \(Optional - for caching and sessions\)
# ============================================
# Redis connection URL
REDIS_URL=""redis://localhost:6379""

# ============================================
# SERVER CONFIGURATION
# ============================================
# Port the server will listen on
PORT=4000

# Environment: development, staging, production
NODE_ENV=development

# ============================================
# FILE UPLOADS
# ============================================
# Directory for storing uploaded files \(relative to project root\)
UPLOAD_DIR=""./uploads""

# Maximum file size in bytes \(5MB = 5242880\)
MAX_FILE_SIZE=5242880

# Allowed file types \(comma-separated\)
ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES=""image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif""

# ============================================
# CORS \(Cross-Origin Resource Sharing\)
# ============================================
# Allowed origins for CORS \(comma-separated\)
# Add your frontend URLs here
CORS_ORIGINS=""http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:3001""

# ============================================
# LOGGING
# ============================================
# Log level: error, warn, info, debug
LOG_LEVEL=info")

Bash(echo "# Backend API URL \(without trailing slash\)
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000/api

# Site URL \(used for generating absolute URLs\)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3001

# Site name
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_NAME=""FemmeLux Admin""")

Bash(echo "# Backend API URL \(without trailing slash\)
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000/api

# Site URL \(used for generating absolute URLs\)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000

# Site name
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_NAME=""FemmeLux Beauty""")

Features:

- Web storefront with Next.js

\)")
